```{r}
library(sf)
library(tidyverse)
library(here)
library(terra)
```

# List files

```{r}
#rand_overlap<-list.files(here("output_data/Random_turbines"), pattern = "overlap", full.names = TRUE)
rand_count<-list.files(here("output_data/Random_turbines"), pattern = "turbines_count", full.names = TRUE)
```

```{r}
rand_count_bind<-rand_count %>% 
   map_dfr(~ read_csv(.x, col_types = cols(.default = col_character())) %>%
            select(-starts_with("...")) %>%
            mutate(source_file = basename(.x))) %>% 
  mutate(num_rand_wind_overlap = as.numeric(num_rand_wind_overlap))
```

```{r}
random_summary_count <- rand_count_bind %>%
  group_by(rgn_key, type) %>%
  summarise(
    random_mean = mean(num_rand_wind_overlap, na.rm = TRUE),
    random_median = median(num_rand_wind_overlap, na.rm = TRUE),
    random_sd = sd(num_rand_wind_overlap, na.rm = TRUE),
    q025 = quantile(num_rand_wind_overlap, 0.025, na.rm = TRUE),
    q975 = quantile(num_rand_wind_overlap, 0.975, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

```


```{r}
test<-random_summary_count %>% 
  filter(random_mean>0)
```

# Convergence

```{r}
convergence <- rand_count_bind %>%
  arrange(rgn_key, type, iteration) %>%
  group_by(rgn_key, type) %>%
  mutate(
    running_mean = cummean(num_rand_wind_overlap),
    running_median = sapply(seq_along(num_rand_wind_overlap), function(i) median(num_rand_wind_overlap[1:i], na.rm = T)),
    running_q025 = sapply(seq_along(num_rand_wind_overlap), function(i) quantile(num_rand_wind_overlap[1:i], 0.025, na.rm = T)),
    running_q975 = sapply(seq_along(num_rand_wind_overlap), function(i) quantile(num_rand_wind_overlap[1:i], 0.975, na.rm = T))
  ) %>%
  ungroup()
```

```{r}
ggplot(convergence,
       aes(x = iteration, y = running_mean, group = interaction(rgn_key, type))) +
  geom_line() +
  facet_grid(type ~ rgn_key, scales = "free_y") +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(
    x = "Number of random iterations",
    y = "Running mean count",
    title = "Convergence of random count estimates"
  )
```

```{r}
diagnostics <- rand_count_bind %>%
  group_by(rgn_key, type) %>%
  summarise(
    n_iter = n_distinct(iteration),
    mean = mean(num_rand_wind_overlap, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd = sd(num_rand_wind_overlap, na.rm = TRUE),
    cv = ifelse(mean == 0, NA, sd / mean),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```



# Read in actual results

```{r}
results<-read.csv(here("output_data/Paolo_results/Collated/Combined_count_by_country.csv"))
```


```{r}
join<-full_join(results, random_summary_count, by = c("rgn_key", "type"))

join2 <- join %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~replace_na(.x, 0)))
```

```{r}
results_compare <- rand_count_bind %>%
  mutate(
    num_rand_wind_overlap = readr::parse_number(as.character(num_rand_wind_overlap))
  ) %>%
  left_join(results, by = c("rgn_key", "type")) %>%
  mutate(
    overlap_wind2 = replace_na(overlap_wind, 0)
  ) %>% 
  group_by(rgn_key, type) %>%
  summarise(
    observed = first(overlap_wind2),
    n_iter = sum(!is.na(num_rand_wind_overlap)),
    rand_mean = mean(num_rand_wind_overlap, na.rm = TRUE),
    rand_sd = sd(num_rand_wind_overlap, na.rm = TRUE),
    rand_q025 = quantile(num_rand_wind_overlap, 0.025, na.rm = TRUE),
    rand_q975 = quantile(num_rand_wind_overlap, 0.975, na.rm = TRUE),
    ses = ifelse(rand_sd == 0, NA_real_, (observed - rand_mean) / rand_sd),
    p_lower = (sum(num_rand_wind_overlap <= observed, na.rm = TRUE) + 1) / (n_iter + 1),
    p_upper = (sum(num_rand_wind_overlap >= observed, na.rm = TRUE) + 1) / (n_iter + 1),
    p_two_sided = pmin(1, 2 * pmin(p_lower, p_upper)),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>% 
  mutate(
    category = case_when(
      p_lower < 0.05 ~ "Lower than random",
      p_upper < 0.05 ~ "Higher than random",
      TRUE ~ "Not different from random"
    )
  )
```


```{r}
rand_count_bind %>%
  filter(rgn_key == "CHN",
         type == "MPA") %>%
  ggplot(aes(num_rand_wind_overlap)) +
  geom_histogram() +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 66)
```

```{r}
write.csv(results_compare, here("output_data/Random_turbines/Random_results_output.csv"))
```
